description: This file defines a wizard interface for generating an account analytic profit report in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form fields, default values, validation, and report invocation.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: Defines a wizard interface for generating an analytic profit report, including form fields, default value methods, validation, and report execution.

methods.name: _date_from
methods.description: Returns the default start date for the report, set to the first day of the current month.

methods.name: _date_to
methods.description: Returns the default end date for the report, set to the current date.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Validates the form data by searching for analytic line records within the specified date range, journal, and employee filters; raises an exception if no records are found.
